item.title: LinkedIn Headshot From Park Photo

turns.text: Can you turn this into a square LinkedIn headshot? A navy blazer and a plain light grey background, please.

item.tests: Creates a polished LinkedIn headshot from the supplied photo while preserving the subject's identity.

answer_sheet.Clothing and background: Navy blazer and plain light grey background.
answer_sheet.Lighting and expression: Natural, approachable and professional; keep my smile.

must_haves: The woman is recognisably the same person as in portrait-woman.jpg, with her curly dark hair retained.
The park is replaced with a plain light grey background.
The square image has a centred head-and-shoulders composition with the full top of her hair visible.
Lighting and skin texture look natural, without obvious facial or clothing artifacts.

turns.text: Can you turn this pic into a square LinkedIn headshot? A navy blazer and a plain light grey background, please. I'm on the free plan and don't want my credits burned, so please tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
Yes—your photo can be edited into a **square LinkedIn headshot with a navy blazer and a plain light-grey background**, while preserving your face and hair.

**Nothing has run or used any credits.**

The cheapest listed approach is:
- **Tool/model:** Image Editor with Flux 2 Klein, available on Free
- **Output:** One square image at **640 × 640**
- **Listed cost:** **Starts at 5 credits**, versus **50 credits** for the dedicated Headshot tool

This combines the clothing and background changes into one edit. A smaller size isn’t offered; “shorter” only applies to video.

**I can’t verify the exact charge or your current balance with the tools available here**, so I can’t promise a firm 5-credit total. Since you want the cost confirmed before spending, I’ll hold off. If you verify the 5-credit price in Magic Hour, would you like to proceed with this smallest, lowest-listed-cost option?

turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused the request because your account has **insufficient credits**. **No image was generated and no credits were spent.**

I attempted only the lowest-listed-cost option: one square, 640px Flux 2 Klein edit, starting at 5 credits. There isn’t a cheaper listed option that makes both changes.

For a no-credit alternative, you could use a free manual editor to replace the background with light grey, though adding a realistic navy blazer would be more involved.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Edit this portrait into a natural, photorealistic professional LinkedIn headshot. Preserve the woman's identity, facial features, natural skin texture, curly dark hair, and gentle expression. Replace the grey knitted sweater with a well-tailored navy blue blazer over a simple professional light-colored top. Replace the outdoor park entirely with a plain, uniform light grey studio background. Use soft flattering studio lighting, realistic skin tones, and a centered head-and-shoulders composition with comfortable headroom. Square crop. No text, logos, accessories, or excessive retouching.
